description: This file contains unit tests for the HonoBasicAuthHandler class within the Eclipse Hono project, validating authentication failure handling and malformed header processing.

classes.name: HonoBasicAuthHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for HonoBasicAuthHandler, testing authentication failure scenarios and malformed header handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, mocking dependencies and configuring the handler.

methods.name: testHandleFailsWithStatusCodeFromAuthProvider
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly fails the context with the error code provided by the auth provider when authentication fails.

methods.name: testHandleFailsForMalformedAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Tests that a malformed authorization header causes the handler to fail with a 400 (Bad Request) error.
